msi_first_attempt.cause: MSI passed from Sandbox shared folder; Windows Installer service cannot access that mapping. Staging on guest local disk succeeded.

native_host_runner.error: Core spawn failed with Windows access denied (os error 5)
native_host_runner.cause: PowerShell Start-Process -Wait creates a process-tree Job that does not permit the Core breakaway flag. Using Start-Process -PassThru followed by WaitForExit fixed the runner; production binaries were unchanged.

diagnostics_fix: Early browser startup error referenced an events function before definition, losing its final failure report. Defer that diagnostic reference until inside the existing protected capture block.
green_edge_first_attempt: Added fixture links wrapped the GitHub anchor. CDP bounding-box center missed actual text, producing no click intent and no handoff. Use the first DOM content quad after scrolling; failure preserved separately.
host_package_preparation: Python default GBK decoding failed on UTF-8 reports before packaging. Explicit UTF-8 reading fixed preparation; no package was produced by that failed attempt.
upgrade_setting_key: The fixture used read field speed_limit_kib instead of write key download_speed_limit_kib; an explicit pre-upgrade readback was added. Original failed report retained; corrected real upgrade passed.
source_archive_line_endings: Git archive of HEAD:extension did not inherit repository-root attributes and core.autocrlf converted line endings. A byte check caught it before desktop writes. Re-export with core.autocrlf=false exactly matched all 123 tracked extension blobs and the full tracked path set.
